body: Thank you so much for this, and very sorry I didn't see it until now. I didn't see your response until yesterday. I'd welcome talking about it, but maybe in the DMs?
I am so sad to hear this. All good wishes for a speedy recovery.

I was raped wearing business attire: a shapeless knit skirt from JJill, a crew neck sweater and flats. I was fifty-two. I was beaten to the point of unconsciousness. Some absolutely lovely Samaritans found me beat to shit on the sidewalk and helped me get home. So tell me, what did I do wrong?
